details.title: Lydian dominant scales
details.lead: Mixolydian with a raised 4th: the scale of a 7♯11 chord, the 4th mode of melodic minor. Each key goes up and down two octaves from its lowest tonic, then over the whole horn: up to the highest note of the scale at or below double high B♭, down to the lowest, and back to the tonic.
facts: All 12, from B♭ up by half steps
